purpose: One finite offline examination of per-modal learning admission; no firmware or hardware action
motivation: Validated67712 real360mswindow: common learning admission differs from command-derived synchronization admission. This is a local mechanism observation, not a global causal or performance finding.
rule: Moving reference only (abs(vref)>1e-8 OR abs(aref)>1e-8), pure normal-rate cause only, useful raw prediction, absolute modal request>=1 equivalent command count: cap regular error-gradient multiplier by min(old multiplier, pre-classification multiplier times clipped admitted/request modal ratio). Sync-only primary; both-modal prespecified scope sensitivity. Do not increase a regular gradient.
implementationRepair: checks01 both-modal native test caught zeroed learning changing stationary-retention eligibility. Explicit moving-reference eligibility added BEFORE any plant screening; retained failing checks01. This protects the unchanged stationary rule, not an outcome-driven gain retune.
separation: Wrong-direction bounded repair and static tracking retention remain original. Do not infer an output-admission condition from a fixed-feature wrong-direction repair guarantee.
unchanged: All allocator, magnitude, slew, sector, speed, tracking, terminal, timing policies and plant equations. Same-state command must equal R2; disabled core/state/output must be byte exact. No controller gain changes.
checks: Float/double same-state and local eligibility/bounds; real binary snapshot baseline plus each recorded-input branch;36 assumed closed-loop cases initially, independent coupling/noise holdout only for candidates passing first screening.
screenDecision: Do not release a candidate with any newly failed completed-R2 case, or no mean sync gain versus R2. Report tracking cost and ordinary BLNN comparison on a fixed baseline-complete population; candidate failures stay visible and invalidate efficacy aggregation for that population. No new candidate search in this batch.
holdout: Coupling stiffness1000/2000/3000; noise periods17/23;36cases per setting, same task and hard guards. Reject new failures or fewer than4/6 settings with mean sync gain. A passing assumed-model screen is still not physical benefit or calibrated-model proof.
